instruction: Attach ~/aws-bill.pdf to the email message. Leave the composition window open and do not transmit the message yet.

metadata.explanation: Variation 9: Uses 'transmit' instead of 'send' with concise instruction. Verifies aws-bill.pdf is attached using check_list metric and show-thunderbird-attachments.py script.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction has TWO requirements (1. attach file, 2. keep composition window open and don't transmit), but evaluator only checks attachment presence
Unverifiable external script: Evaluator depends on 'show-thunderbird-attachments.py' downloaded from external URL - cannot verify if script correctly detects attachments or outputs expected string
No verification of non-transmission: Instruction explicitly requires NOT transmitting the email, but evaluator does not check if email was sent or composition window is still open
Fragile string matching: Success depends on exact string 'Attachment added!' - any variation in script output (case, phrasing) will cause false negatives
Timing assumptions: Script runs in postconfig after agent completes task - no guarantee Thunderbird state hasn't changed (window closed, email sent)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add verification that composition window is still open (check accessibility tree or process state for Thunderbird compose window)
Add verification that email was NOT sent (check Thunderbird sent folder is empty or composition draft still exists)
Replace external script with verifiable getter that reads Thunderbird's composition state directly (e.g., parse draft mbox file or use Thunderbird profile data)
If keeping external script, add fallback checks or make the script's source code part of the task definition so its logic can be validated
